summary: 16-bit variant of the MPEG Audio Layer 3 IMDCT synthesis filterbank, structurally a twin of IMDCTSynthesisFilterbank (0052a6ec). Stage one runs an 8-iteration butterfly over two 16-bit frequency-domain inputs (a1, a3) with reduced-precision rotation coefficients (362/473/669/277 applied with >> 8) and writes eight results to the a2 output buffer. Stage two re-reads that buffer and performs eight windowed byte-coefficient lookups into a6 (index (x >> 5) & 0x3FF) per iteration, writing eight output bytes through the a5 + a4[offset] pointer.

local_names.a1: first frequency-domain input vector (16-bit subband samples)
local_names.a3: second frequency-domain input vector (16-bit subband samples)
local_names.a2: output buffer (16-bit) for the butterfly stage, re-read as the stage-two input
local_names.a4: dword offset table indexing into the a5 region
local_names.a5: base of the time-domain byte output region

operations.description: Stage-one loop: do-while 8 iterations (v50 countdown from 8); each iteration advances input pointers a1/a3 and the output pointer v47 by one 16-bit element.
Butterfly group on element indices 0/16/32/48 (a1 and a3): products a1[i]*a3[i] combined with the 362 (>>8) rotation coefficient, forming v52/v53/v57/v59/v10/v11/v54/v61.
Butterfly group on element indices 8/24/40/56 (a1 and a3): products combined with rotation coefficients 473/669/277/362 (all >> 8), forming v63/v64/v20-v24/v12-v19.

Store eight stage-one results into the a2 output buffer as 16-bit pair sums/differences at indices 0/8/16/24/32/40/48/56: v47[0]=v57+v19, v47[56]=v57-v19, v47[8]=v61+v23, v47[48]=v61-v23, v47[16]=v54+v24, v47[40]=v54-v24, v47[32]=v59+v20, v47[24]=v59-v20.
Stage-two loop: do-while 8 iterations (v51 countdown from 8); each iteration reads a dword index from the a4 offset table (v49 += 4) and forms the output pointer v25 = a5 + index.
Second butterfly pass over the stage-one a2 buffer (v48[0..7]): recomputes the same rotation structure with coefficients 362/473/669/277 to form v55/v56/v58/v60/v62/v65-v67/v40-v43.
Window lookup: eight byte coefficient reads per iteration from the a6 table at index (x >> 5) & 0x3FF, written to output bytes v25[0..7] (pair sums and differences).
Return the stage-two loop countdown result (the final value of v51, which reaches 0).
Invoked by RenderModeBranch (0x005285A6) to synthesize time-domain audio samples.

unresolved: Prelabel is a cluster-copy from structural twin IMDCTSynthesisFilterbank (0052a6ec) at DERIVED trust; the exact coefficient/scale differences (362/473/669/277 vs 6270/4433/15137/... and >>5 vs >>18 window indexing) are observed but not independently proven as a distinct filter variant.
ABI prototype is recorded from legacy evidence only (abi:lead) and has not been independently verified.
No guard conditions exist in the raw source; both loops are fixed-count with no early exit.
The a6 coefficient table and the a4/a5 pointer construction share the same inference caveat as 0052a6ec.
